title: Cryostasis
description: Explore Santa's ship as a text adventure, collect items, and find the right weight to pass security.
writeup:
## Approach

This is a text adventure driven by Intcode. The solution automates the entire exploration and puzzle-solving process.

## Part 1

The droid explores the ship via BFS, parsing room descriptions to discover doors and items. Dangerous items (infinite loop, giant electromagnet, molten lava, photons, escape pod) are blacklisted — picking them up causes an instant game over.

After mapping all rooms and collecting all safe items, the droid navigates to the Security Checkpoint. It then tries all 2^n combinations of items (n is typically ~8, so at most 256 attempts) by dropping everything, picking up a subset, and stepping onto the pressure-sensitive floor. When the floor accepts the weight, it outputs a password.

## Part 2

Day 25 Part 2 is awarded for completing all 49 other stars — no additional puzzle.
